visual_brief: DENSE WEB of taut RED YARN THREADS — straight lines stretched between anchor points, NOT noise/curves. Single saturated hue near #c20018 (blood-red). Tens of thousands of segments visible.
ONE PALE SUSPENDED SPHERE — off-white, cottony or stone-like, occupying ~20% of the right side of the frame. The still center within the agitated network.
Small DARK FRAGMENTS caught within the thread mesh — paper / charred matter / stones. Sparse, irregular, never grid-aligned.
Architectural / walk-in scale — the camera is INSIDE the web, looking up and around, not at the work from outside.
Background: deep neutral / black void — the yarn IS the work. Negative space is part of the composition.
Threads converge around the suspended sphere like blood vessels around a heart, or like a circulatory cosmos around a moon.
channel_directive: Channel Chiharu Shiota's web-network DNA from chiharu-shiota-skill SKILL.md (red taut LINE SEGMENTS — never points, never curves; one suspended object as the still center; black void background; architectural in-the-web camera; presence-in-absence as concept). PERFORMANCE BUDGET (HARD): no more than 20,000 line segments total (a single THREE.LineSegments BufferGeometry, two vertices each = 40,000 position floats × 3). Use THREE.LineSegments + LineBasicMaterial ONLY (additive blending, opacity 0.04-0.10, single red hue ~#c20018) — DO NOT use ShaderMaterial on the threads (it has caused render-gate timeouts). The suspended sphere should be a single THREE.Mesh with SphereGeometry(radius, 24, 16) + MeshBasicMaterial OR MeshStandardMaterial (white/cream, ~0.6 emissive intensity if standard). NO custom ShaderMaterial on the sphere either. The camera slowly dollies INSIDE the network on a gentle path — not orbiting from outside. NO noise-driven motion on threads — they're static or breathe via tiny anchor jitter (<0.5% length variation). Pieces from this seed live on a separate aesthetic branch from attractors / boids / differential growth — they're INSTALLATIONS, not simulations. The piece must produce a clearly visible (>5% non-background pixels) screenshot within 5 seconds of load — if the line count or shader complexity prevents that, scale down.
